standards.title: General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)
standards.applies_because: No harmonised surfboard standard: the General Product Safety Regulation applies

standards.title: REACH — Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals
standards.applies_because: REACH: resins, hardeners and foam additives (SVHC declaration)

standards.title: Plastics — Determination of flexural properties
standards.applies_because: Flexural properties of the laminate (3-point bending of coupons)
standards.citation_note: Standard to be confirmed (edition and applicability) — no verified citation URL

risks.risk: Board snaps or creases under a heavy landing
risks.mitigation: Stringer or carbon rail bands; 3-point bending test on coupons and full board
Pull-out test on the fin system, reinforcement patch under the box

risks.risk: Delamination and water ingress into the core
risks.mitigation: Vent plug (EPS), vacuum-bagged laminate, sealed inserts

risks.risk: Too little volume for the rider → hard paddling, late planing
risks.mitigation: Size volume from rider weight and level (litres per kg guideline)
UV-stabilised epoxy, hot coat with UV blocker

tests.name: 3-point flex of laminate coupons and full board
tests.method: Load-deflection to failure on coupons; proof load on a board

tests.name: Fin box pull-out
tests.method: Pull along the fin axis to failure

tests.name: Drop / impact on rails (ding resistance)
tests.method: Falling-weight impact on rail and deck

tests.name: Water absorption after 24 h immersion
tests.method: Weigh before/after with a pierced laminate patch

tests.name: Salt-water + UV exposure of fittings
tests.method: Inserts and plugs, visual + pull-out after exposure

checks.name: Interference between moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Boolean common of every part pair (OCCT), classified by the assembly joints; total 0.0 mm³

checks.threshold: 0 intersecting pairs > 0.01 mm³ between parts that move relative to each other (different rigid bodies, over their motion study) or across a parting line — CAD interference-check practice
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) per pair of solids at the assembled pose and over each moving joint's motion study

checks.name: Overlaps inside rigid bodies (concept geometry)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: 2 pairs of rigidly joined parts interpenetrate (0 over 5 % of the smaller part)

checks.threshold: Parts of one rigid body should not interpenetrate: overlap > 5 % of the smaller part = concept geometry to pocket at detail design (warn); smaller overlaps are seats (info)
checks.formula: V(A ∩ B) for parts of the same rigid body that are not directly joined

checks.name: Minimum clearance of moving parts

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Lower bound: no moving part has a neighbour within 12 mm (or no moving joint)

checks.formula: min over poses of d(moving subtree, other parts); revolute props 12 poses / 360°, buttons pressed 0.5 mm

checks.name: Screw engagement vs insert / thread

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Material under each screw measured by a line ∩ solid on both parts; flange capped at 2·d (counterbore), screw = shortest ISO length reaching the insert / thread

checks.threshold: Heat-set insert: boss holds the insert + 0.5 mm and the screw engages ≥ 80 % of it (McMaster-Carr 94459A insert data); tapped metal ≥ 1.5·d; thread-forming screw in plastic ≥ 2·d (EJOT DELTA PT design guide)
checks.formula: engagement = min(insert length, screw length − flange); boss depth = material of the threaded part
notes: Fin 1 → Body: 2 × M2.5×10 + insert M2.5×4, engagement ≥ 4.0 mm, pass
Fin 2 → Body: 2 × M2.5×10 + insert M2.5×4, engagement ≥ 4.0 mm, pass
Fin 3 → Body: 2 × M2.5×10 + insert M2.5×4, engagement ≥ 4.0 mm, pass

checks.name: Fasteners by standard

value.label: estimate
value.source_or_assumption: Joint rules (screws per parting-line perimeter, motor mounts, spring bars); sizes from the part scale

checks.formula: Σ fasteners over the assembly joints
notes: 6 × screw M2.5×10 (ISO 14583 (hexalobular pan head), A2 stainless)

checks.name: Joint closure (build123d Joints)

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Each child re-placed from its joint frame with build123d RigidJoint / RevoluteJoint / LinearJoint.connect_to; 4 joints

checks.threshold: build123d joints re-place every part at its modelled pose: residual < 0.01 mm
checks.formula: |bbox centre after connect_to − modelled bbox centre|

checks.name: Every part is attached

value.label: measured
value.source_or_assumption: Parts with no contact (≤ 0.05 mm, BRepExtrema) with the part they are joined to

checks.threshold: Every part touches the part it is joined to (contact ≤ 0.05 mm)
checks.formula: d(child, parent) ≤ 0.05 mm for every joint

prototype.enclosure_method: CNC-shaped EPS blank + hand-laid epoxy/glass (per litre)

enclosure_volume.label: measured
enclosure_volume.source_or_assumption: Enclosure solid volume measured on the STEP (stage 3)

cost_lines.item: Enclosure: CNC-shaped EPS blank + hand-laid epoxy/glass (per litre)

assembly_steps: Export the outline and rocker from the CAD to the shaping machine
CNC-shape an EPS blank, hand-finish rails
Laminate epoxy/glass (4+4 oz deck, 4 oz bottom), install fin boxes and vent plug
Weigh the finished board, check volume by water displacement
Test-ride with two rider weights and log speed with a GPS watch

total_cost.label: estimate
total_cost.source_or_assumption: Sum of the prototype cost lines

build_strategy.title: Full design
build_strategy.explanation: You design the whole product: every part, the BOM and (if any) the simple electronics are yours, and a factory builds to your CAD and drawings. This is how mechanical products and simple electronics are made.
not_customisable: Foam blanks, fin boxes, fins from suppliers
